title: Five AI Image Providers, One Job: Never Fail | vitalii.no
description:
Relying on a single AI image provider was a constant headache. One service would hit rate limits, another would occasionally return content I couldn't use, and a third was a coin toss on quality. That added up to roughly a 25% failure rate — broken content, manual retries, and wasted time every single day.

I built a cascading image generation service that starts with one provider and automatically falls back through four more if it stalls or fails. Each call runs inside a Supabase Edge Function with a strict 40-second timeout so nothing gets stuck waiting. Every attempt is logged to an image_provider_usage table, and the admin panel lets me reorder the fallback chain in real time based on which providers are actually performing.

Image generation success climbed from about 75% with a single provider to a consistent 98%+, with zero manual retries needed.
